sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface detection confirmed by anti-Flag antibody staining in transfected N2a cells (L3); Western blot with anti-epitope-tag antibody confirmed expression (L5). No functional assay reported in the ledger clips.
sites.rationale: PROM1 is a pentaspan membrane protein with its N-terminus extracellular (after SP cleavage at residue 19) and its C-terminus intracellular (residues 814-865); it therefore has exactly ONE extracellular terminus. No ledger line names a specific residue for the FLAG insertion, so the position is topology-derived: the tag must sit after the SP cleavage site (insert_after_residue=19, residue_before=S, residue_after=G at position 20). Python confirmed residue 19 is S and residue 20 is G. The insert position is 88 residues from TM1 (residue 107), well within the large extracellular N-terminal domain. Full-length FLAG-tagged mouse/human PROM1 constructs (including splice variants s8 and s8(-Ex19)) were cloned by Gibson assembly into pcDNA3.1+ and transfected into Neuro 2a cells; anti-Flag antibody detected the tag on the cell surface, confirming extracellular FLAG placement on a membrane-anchored construct.

sources.claim: The cDNA were transfected in N2a cells and their expression was probed with mAB 13A4, ab27699 and anti-Flag antibodies.

literature_notes: All five ledger lines (L1-L5) describe the same experimental system: FLAG-tagged full-length PROM1 constructs generated by Gibson assembly in pcDNA3.1+ and expressed in Neuro 2a cells to map the mAB 13A4 epitope. None of the clips names a specific residue or junction for the FLAG insertion. Because PROM1 has exactly one extracellular terminus (the mature N-terminus after SP cleavage at residue 19), the position is topology-derived rather than validated. L2 mentions the 'third extracellular loop' (ECL3, residues 510-792) as the region containing the mAB 13A4 epitope, but this is antibody epitope mapping — not a tag insertion site — and is explicitly excluded by the ledger rules. No intracellular or function-abrogating positions are named in the ledger. The C-terminus (814-865) is intracellular and does not qualify as a surface tag site.
